item.title: Perry Johnson targets Rep. John James in new campaign ad

item.title: Kristi Noem is out as Homeland Security secretary, Trump says
item.description: President Trump announced Thursday on social media that he is replacing his embattled Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem with Oklahoma Republican Sen. Markwayne Mullin.
